CSV 转换：全部可用目标CSV conversions: every available target

CSV 看起来只是一堆逗号，真正麻烦的是解析前的类型判断：`1/2` 是日期还是分数，`00123` 是邮编还是数字。这条管线先按 `raw` 读入，再把明确是数字的字段恢复成数字，其余保持原字符——这是它能被信任的原因，也是它不会替你做更多猜测的原因。A CSV looks like commas, but the hard part happens before parsing: is `1/2` a date or a fraction, is `00123` a postcode or a number? This pipeline reads raw first and only restores fields that are unambiguously numeric, leaving everything else as the characters it found. That is why it can be trusted, and why it will not guess further than that.

这个来源格式的共同限制What holds for every target from this source

  • 编码按 BOM、NUL 与 UTF-8 → GB18030 → GBK 的严格顺序判定；四种都不成立时报解码失败，不产出乱码Encoding is decided by BOM, NUL and the strict UTF-8 → GB18030 → GBK chain; if none holds, the route reports a decode failure rather than writing mojibake
  • CSV 没有标题层级、合并单元格或样式；表格之外的东西本来就不存在A CSV has no heading hierarchy, merged cells or styling; anything outside the grid never existed
  • 一列里混用日期与数字时按字段各自判断，不做整列强制转换A column mixing dates and numbers is judged field by field rather than coerced as a whole
  • 一个 CSV 文件只对应一张表；多文件批次按文件各出一份结果One CSV file is one table; a multi-file batch produces one result per file

常见问题Questions people actually ask

`00123` 会被当成数字 123 吗？Will `00123` become the number 123?

只有整列都表现为数值时才会恢复成数字；带前导零的账号、邮编会保持原字符。日期同理：先确认它是工作簿能识别的日期，才规范化，避免把 `1/2` 猜成某一天。A field is restored to a number only when it is unambiguously numeric; an account or postcode with a leading zero keeps its characters. Dates work the same way: the reader normalises one only after recognising it as a date, so `1/2` is not guessed into a particular day.

CSV 转 PDF 后表格能编辑吗？Is the table in a CSV to PDF result editable?

不能。PDF 路线把表格渲染成 A4 页面图像，文字不可选中。需要保留数据请选 Excel 或 JSON；需要可编辑文档请选 Word。No. The PDF route renders the table into A4 page images, so the text is not selectable. Choose Excel or JSON to keep the data, or Word for an editable document.

多张表能一起转吗？Can several tables be converted together?

把多个 CSV 放进同一批次，整批共用一个目标格式，每个文件各出一份结果；需要一次拿走时用 ZIP。一个 CSV 内部不会被拆成多张表。Put several CSV files in one batch: they share a target and each produces its own result, with a ZIP when you want them in one download. A single CSV is never split into several tables.

GBK 编码的 CSV 能读吗？Can a GBK-encoded CSV be read?

能。先看 BOM 与 NUL，再依次尝试严格 UTF-8、GB18030、GBK；解出的文字还要通过控制字符闸门。若全部失败，会明确报解码失败，而不是产出一份乱码。Yes. The reader checks BOM and NUL, then tries strict UTF-8, GB18030 and GBK, with a control-character gate on the result. If all fail it reports a decode failure rather than writing mojibake.

不需要账号，也不需要联网：装好扩展后点图标，在新标签页里打开工作台，文件从磁盘直接选。No account and no network: install the extension, click its icon, and the workbench opens in a new tab reading straight off your disk.
